Track A stops here. Its three Ranked-list items park, and the roadmap stays live for Track B.

**Tool calls for this step:**

1. `Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/references/deferred-backlog.md`. This gets the exact Deferred-item schema before I write any item.
2. `Read specs/deferred_items.md`. This checks whether the file exists and what form its sections take.
3. `Edit specs/deferred_items.md`. This appends a section `## lock-closures — 2026-11-06` with one item per list entry, each self-contained per the schema:
   - **O2: 7-day closure-risk outlook per lock.** Built from the river-level forecast and Stage 1's curve (specs/lock-closures-stage-1-findings.md). Size: small, one model run a day; the basis is Stage 1's 22-minute fit. Done when: each lock has a 7-day closure-risk outlook from the river-level forecast.
   - **O3: Separate closure curves for all 14 locks, pooled.** Size: about 14 × Stage 1's 1.8 GB, so roughly 25 GB. Stage 1 found the four longest-record locks share close to the same curve, which may lower the value of this item. Done when: there is a closure curve for each of the 14 locks, pooled across locks, fit on real data.
   - **O4: Closure-history map for boat operators.** Size: about a day of work, one static map page. Done when: boat operators can open a map of each lock's closure history.
4. `Edit specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md`. Under `## Ranked list — Track A`, this replaces the three items with: `Track A stopped 2026-11-06 — the Stage 1 curve answers the question. O2, O3, O4 parked to specs/deferred_items.md (lock-closures — 2026-11-06).`
5. `git add specs/deferred_items.md specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md && git commit -m "lock-closures roadmap: stop Track A, park O2–O4"` on `main`.

**One more thing blocks the handoff to Stage 2.** It is the only unticked stage. Its `Consumes` asks for "the closure log's live feed", but no stage produces a live feed. Stage 1 produced only its findings file, and plan 4's Handoff reads `None`. So Stage 2's `Consumes` is unmet, and I won't hand it off until that is settled.

My proposed default is to amend Stage 2's `Consumes` to read "the closure log Stage 1 read, polled every 10 minutes (O5's cost basis)". Under that reading, no new stage is needed. The alternative is to add a stage before Stage 2 that produces a real live feed, if polling the log isn't good enough or the log isn't reachable that way.

**Approve the amended `Consumes`, or amend it (for example, add the feed stage)?**
